What is the story of Friday Nights Lights?

Friday Night Lights is an American drama television series about a high school football team in the fictional town of Dillon, Texas. It was based on the 1990 nonfiction book by H.G. Bissinger, A Town , a Team , and a Dream, adapted as the 2004 film of the same name. The series' primary setting, Dillon, is a small, close-knit community in rural Texas. Team coach Eric Taylor (Kyle Chandler) and his family, wife Tami (a guidance counselor turned principal), Julie, and Grace, are featured. The show uses this small-town backdrop to address many issues facing contemporary American culture, including family values and lack of economic opportunities.
What about Game of Thrones?

Game of Thrones is an American fantasy drama television series. It is based on A Song of Ice and Fire, George R.R. Martin's series of fantasy novels, the first of which is A Game of Thrones. It premiered on HBO in the United States on April 17, 2011. The series will conclude with its eighth season in 2019.
The story is set in the fictional Seven Kingdoms of Westeros and the continent of Essos. It chronicles the violent dynastic struggles among the realm's noble families for the Iron Throne, while other families fight for independence from it. The series opens with additional threats in the icy North and Essos in the east.
Like the novel, season 2 follows the dramatic death of Lord Eddard "Ned" Stark, with all of the Starks being separated across Westeros. The season mainly centers around the war of the five kings, fought between the leaders of Westerosi factions who are either staking a claim on the Iron Throne or seeking independence from it.
The next season follows the climactic battle at Kings Landing. Like the previous seasons, it mainly centers around the war of the five kings; after the death of Renly Baratheon, all four kings in Westeros believe to have a claim to the Iron Throne, besides Robb Stark, who seeks vengeance for the death of his father, Lord Eddard "Ned" Stark.
Did Game of Thrones receive any awards?

Yes, Game of Thrones has received numerous awards,  including 38 Primetime Emmy Awards, 5 Screen Actors Guild Award, and a Peabody Award. It holds the record for the most Emmy Awards won by a series in a single year, with 12 awards in 2015. Additionally, it has received numerous nominations and awards for its acting, writing, directing, and production values.
How much money did Game of Thrones cost?

As of April 2013, Northern Ireland Screen gave the show £ 9.25 million ( $14.37 million ); according to government estimates, the Northern Ireland economy has benefited  by £ 65 million ( $100.95 million ). The first season's budget was estimated at $50 -- 60 million. In the second season, the show received a 15 percent budget increase. The sixth season budget was over $10 million per episode, for a season total of over $100 million and a series record.

Game of Thrones was broadcast by HBO in the United States, however, I do not have the current information.
How many actors were involved with Game of Thrones?

There are five main cast members, Peter Dinklage, Nikolaj Coster - Waldau, Lena Headey, Emilia Clarke, and Kit Harington. Game of Thrones has an ensemble cast estimated to be the largest on television; during its third season, 257 cast names were recorded.
